Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "so this is for the north wall gear check on thursday morning and i want to forward the inspection sheet to leah before the route setting meeting she is covering the loaner rack this week and she asked me to send the findings while they are still easy to match with the tags the sheet has the date the inspector initials and the location for each item first the two blue harnesses were checked for worn webbing and readable labels second the gray rope bags were opened and the rope ends were checked for fraying third the locking carabiners from the teaching kit were tested for gate action and the serial numbers were written down the orange helmet on the lower shelf has a cracked buckle and that note is already on the sheet the other helmets had no visible cracks during this check i also wrote that the spare slings were not included because they were out with the youth group leah can compare the notes with the wall log when she gets in but i am not asking her to approve anything please forward the sheet as it is with the photos attached and tell me if the attachment does not come through i will be at the front desk until noon then in the equipment room", "output": "So this is for the north wall gear check on Thursday morning, and I want to forward the inspection sheet to Leah before the route-setting meeting. She is covering the loaner rack this week, and she asked me to send the findings while they are still easy to match with the tags. The sheet has the date, the inspector initials, and the location for each item. First, the two blue harnesses were checked for worn webbing and readable labels. Second, the gray rope bags were opened, and the rope ends were checked for fraying. Third, the locking carabiners from the teaching kit were tested for gate action, and the serial numbers were written down. The orange helmet on the lower shelf has a cracked buckle, and that note is already on the sheet. The other helmets had no visible cracks during this check. I also wrote that the spare slings were not included because they were out with the youth group. Leah can compare the notes with the wall log when she gets in, but I am not asking her to approve anything. Please forward the sheet as it is, with the photos attached, and tell me if the attachment does not come through. I will be at the front desk until noon, then in the equipment room."}]
